# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and aligns HarfBuzz binding generation with bundled native sources. The HarfBuzz managed surface follows the pinned native revision while correcting a combining-class name and removing aggregate flag masks.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed** — The misspelled `CCC133` member is now `CCC132`, matching the upstream HarfBuzz name while retaining numeric value 132. Replace references to the old member before upgrading.
- **Aggregate HarfBuzz flag masks are unavailable** — `GlyphFlags.Defined` is removed, and equivalent aggregate `Defined` masks are not exposed for buffer flags. Combine the concrete flags your code requires instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — The bundled renderer moves to the Skia m154 release line. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **HarfBuzz bindings follow bundled native sources** — Binding generation now derives from the HarfBuzz revision pinned in Skia DEPS, keeping supported types and enum values synchronized with the library shipped in the package.

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update and the aligned HarfBuzz binding-generation model.
